subtracting2400000.5. Position units are au; velocities are au/day. Raw responses
preserve JPL#54 orbit metadata. New radii/longitudes reproduce original cached
tracks to <5e-8au and <2.1e-6deg, respectively (extraction_validation.json).

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Compare existing CT probe temperature and |B| with native spacecraft hours.
+
+This supplemental diagnostic never selects a reference, changes calibration,
+launches a model, or fits a phase/amplitude. The imported native-hour helper is
+the one used by analyze_native_model.py.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+import argparse
+import csv
+from datetime import datetime,timezone
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+import numpy as np
+from astropy.time import Time
+from analyze_native_model import MONITORS,average_at_native,metric
+from case_selection import case_provenance,completed,safe_name
+
+ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+KB=1.380649e-23  # exact SI Boltzmann constant, J/K
+FIELDS=('temperature_K','B_magnitude_nT')
+START='2025-11-25T00:00:00'
+STOP='2025-12-06T00:00:00'
+
+
+def sha(path):
+    digest=hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open('rb') as stream:
+        for block in iter(lambda:stream.read(1048576),b''):digest.update(block)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def number(value):
+    return float(value) if value is not None and value.strip() else float('nan')
+
+
+def derived_fields(density_cm3,pressure_npa,br_nt,btheta_nt,bphi_nt):
+    density=np.asarray(density_cm3,dtype=float);pressure=np.asarray(pressure_npa,dtype=float)
+    valid=np.isfinite(density)&np.isfinite(pressure)&(density>0)&(pressure>0)
+    temperature=np.full(density.shape,np.nan)
+    np.divide(pressure*1e-9,2*density*1e6*KB,out=temperature,where=valid)
+    magnitude=np.sqrt(np.asarray(br_nt)**2+np.asarray(btheta_nt)**2+np.asarray(bphi_nt)**2)
+    return dict(temperature_K=temperature,B_magnitude_nT=magnitude)
+
+
+def pairing_masks(observed,model,covered):
+    observed_valid=np.isfinite(observed)&(observed>0)
+    model_valid=np.isfinite(model)&(model>0)
+    paired=covered&observed_valid&model_valid
+    return observed_valid,model_valid,paired
+
+
+def finite_json(value):
+    if isinstance(value,dict):return {k:finite_json(v) for k,v in value.items()}
+    if isinstance(value,(list,tuple)):return [finite_json(v) for v in value]
+    if isinstance(value,(float,np.floating)) and not np.isfinite(value):return None
+    if isinstance(value,np.generic):return value.item()
+    return value
+
+
+def load_probe(path,origin):
+    records={monitor:[] for monitor in MONITORS}
+    by_id={value[0]:key for key,value in MONITORS.items()}
+    with path.open() as stream:
+        for row in csv.DictReader(stream):
+            monitor=by_id.get(int(row['probe_id']))
+            if monitor is None:continue
+            records[monitor].append([number(row['day'])+origin,*[number(row[k]) for k in ['n_cm3','p_npa','Br_nt','Btheta_nt','Bphi_nt']]])
+    result={}
+    for monitor,rows in records.items():
+        if not rows:raise ValueError('Missing native spacecraft probe: '+str(path)+' '+monitor)
+        values=np.asarray(rows);values=values[np.argsort(values[:,0])]
+        if not np.isfinite(values[:,0]).all() or np.any(np.diff(values[:,0])<=0):raise ValueError('Nonfinite/nonunique probe UTC: '+monitor)

+
+
+def diagnostic(cases,output_dir):

+    origin=float(metadata['origin_mjd_utc']);start,stop=Time([START,STOP],format='isot',scale='utc').mjd
+    training_stop=Time(metadata['calibration_interval_utc'][1],format='isot',scale='utc').mjd

+        stamps=np.asarray([number(r['mjd_utc']) for r in rows])
+        if not len(stamps) or np.any(np.diff(stamps)<=0):raise ValueError('Missing/nonunique observation UTC: '+monitor)
+        base=stamps-(.5/24 if monitor=='wind' else 0)
+        after_training=base>=training_stop
+        observations[monitor]=dict(mjd=stamps,base=base,after_training=after_training,
+                                  **{field:np.asarray([number(r[field]) for r in rows]) for field in FIELDS})
+        provenance=ROOT/f'observations/raw/hapi_mhd_{monitor}.csv.provenance.json'
+        source_context[monitor]=json.loads(pin(provenance).read_text())
+    result=dict(schema='native_CT_thermomagnetic_v1',author='Codex-solver',created_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+                requested_cases=cases,time_convention='physical_geometric_UTC',requested_start_utc=START,requested_stop_exclusive_utc=STOP,

+                             pressure='total hydrogen-fluid pressure p=2 np kB Tp under Te=Tp',
+                             interpretation='Model Tp is inferred under the equal electron/proton temperature closure; separate electron and proton temperatures are not evolved or independently measured by this model.'),
+                field_definition='sqrt(Br_nt^2+Btheta_nt^2+Bphi_nt^2), invariant under orthonormal basis rotation',
+                averaging='Derive Tp and |B| at each saved probe epoch, then call the unchanged average_at_native: 61-point/1-minute trapezoid means; Wind [stamp-0.5h,stamp+0.5h], COHO [stamp,stamp+1h]. No extrapolation and no bridging gaps over90minutes.',
+                comparison_location='Actual STEREO-A/Solar-Orbiter probe locations. Wind-selected OMNI is already propagated to near Earth, compared with Earth probe1 without a second transport correction.',
+                mask_definition='Separate finite-positive observed/model masks for each field; a complete modeled native hour and post-training window are additionally required. Every requested observation row remains in paired_samples.tsv with masks.',
+                empirical_pass_or_reference_selection=None,retuned_calibration=False,fitted_phase_or_amplitude=False,forward_runs=0,
+                source_data_context=source_context,case_provenance={},cases={},
+                limitations=['This supplements density/speed/flux residuals; it is not a new calibration or an independent selection rule.',
+                    'Wind is excluded from normalization training as an instrument. STEREO-A/Solar Orbiter provide post-training temporal validation. Subsequent scenario choice guided by these residuals would not be a blind test.',
+                    'Reported means are averages of Tp and scalar |B|, not ratios of averaged pressure/density or the magnitude of an averaged magnetic vector.',

+                    'Model hourly sampling and the inherited quadrature smooth unresolved variability. Source cadence and pressure-closure errors remain physical limitations.'])
+    table=[]
+    for case in cases:
+        safe_name(case)
+        if not case.startswith('ct') or not completed(ROOT,case):raise ValueError('Only explicit completed CT cases accepted: '+case)
+        folder=ROOT/'results'/case
+        provenance=case_provenance(ROOT,case);result['case_provenance'][case]=provenance
+        for record in provenance['files'].values():pin(ROOT/record['path'])
+        for name in ['candidate_status.json','code_selection.json','input_code_provenance.json']:
+            pin(folder/name)
+        probes=load_probe(folder/'probe.csv',origin)
+        result['cases'][case]={}
+        for monitor,track in probes.items():

+                record['fields'][field]=dict(observed_finite_positive_rows=int(observed_valid.sum()),model_finite_positive_hours=int(model_valid.sum()),
+                    paired_positive_finite_hours=int(paired.sum()),not_covered_by_complete_model_hour=int((~covered).sum()),
